[SWS_MemIf_00019]
Upstream requirements: SRS_SPAL_12078, SRS_MemHwAb_14021
⌈If only one memory abstraction module is configured, the Memory Abstraction In-
terface shall be implemented as a set of macros mapping the Memory Abstraction
Interface API to the API of the corresponding memory abstraction module.⌋
Example:
#define MemIf_Write(DeviceIndex, BlockNumber, DataPtr) \
Fee_Write(BlockNumber, DataPtr)
